description: Explicit allowlist for Microsoft source families that remain Missing only because their product responsibility is deliberately deferred beyond the already-completed Rust ownership slices. Any effective Missing contract outside this list fails the global inventory gate.

sources.reason: Only ReadingDbcsCharsPadsOutputArray remains: Rust owns DBCS padding/order once encoded bytes are supplied, but CP_JAPANESE conversion remains a Windows codepage adapter responsibility.

Safe Rust now owns the screen-buffer reflow-color, tab-stop, horizontal and vertical scrolling/line-edit, wide-glyph movement, rectangular-area, alternate-buffer lifecycle/resize/terminal-scrolling, deferred-main resize coordination, portable and reflow-coordinated virtual-bottom, hyperlink-map, portable cursor/margins/origin movement, saved-cursor, cursor-presentation, DECALN screen-alignment, terminal LNM/DECSCNM/DECAWM/DECECM modes, erase/selective-protection/RIS reset behavior including scrollback-aware Erase All, extended SGR/cell-attribute, OSC 133 command-region, delayed-wrap/multiline-autowrap, LF/IND/NEL viewport-plus-margin coordination, dynamic OSC palette/default-color/DEC color-alias resolution, DEC HLS/RGB color-definition restore behavior, DECSTR cursor/origin/alternate-state coordination, host-style word-boundary/trim-leading-zero semantics, portable CSI 8 t/DECCOLM resize coordination with current-attribute preservation, host/WriteCharsLegacy printable-plus-backspace behavior preserving symbolic modern attributes including prompt-line DCH composition, and plain-viewport reverse-index behavior at both zero and nonzero viewport origins; the remaining methods require traditional-resize, inactive-control-character, offscreen-color or other isolated coordination state.
The C++ iterator operator API has no direct migrated Rust product abstraction.
Terminal application command-line behavior remains native product logic.
Filtered-command product action semantics remain native.
TerminalApp settings integration remains native product logic.
